title: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
visualBrief: Specific Kapaleeshwarar standing core: twelve mapped gateway/shrine/mandapa/perimeter-roof envelopes, tall seven-tier eastern gopuram and smaller western gopuram with true through-passages, granite bases and receding painted bands/central niches, curved crests/finials and original simplified sculptural vocabulary. Two inner shrine roof masses, real open pillared mandapas, red/white parapet rhythms, stone plinths and brass flagstaff. Courtyards, tank, streets and independent surrounding buildings stay host context. No copied deity/narrative/text atlas or complete ritual interior.

sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Picture-led eastern tower about37m including6m granite base, seven receding painted storeys and curved crest/finials; western tower about16m with three levels.
